C# — Texture Alignment

Correspond EpicEye.Alignment.cs, is a pure local computing module. The outsider direction is unified to depth/The cloud coordinates are linked to the texture camera coordinates:`P_texture = R × P_depth + T`.

API Reference

AlignTextureFromDepth

Purpose: Rewind the depth map to 3D, project it to texture by external referencing, and sample it double-linearly for each active depth pixel. The output grid is the same as the depth map.

Parameters

Name Type Description

depth

float[]

Depth data in millimeters.

depthW

int

Value of depthW.

depthH

int

Value of depthH.

texture

byte[]

Texture image data.

textureW

int

Value of textureW.

textureH

int

Value of textureH.

matType

int

Value of matType.

depthIntrinsic

Matrix3x3

Value of depthIntrinsic.

textureIntrinsic

Matrix3x3

Value of textureIntrinsic.

textureDistortion

Distortion

Value of textureDistortion.

rotation

Matrix3x3

Value of rotation.

translation

double[]

Value of translation.

Returns: byte[]?`size `depthW×depthH×3×channelBytes;failed as null.

AlignTextureFromPointCloud

Purpose: It’s gonna be orderly. XYZ A cloud projection to a texture camera with the same output grid as the input cloud.

Parameters

Name Type Description

pointCloud

float[]

Point-cloud option or point-cloud data.

int

Value of pointCloudW.

int

Value of pointCloudH.

byte[]

Texture image data.

int

Value of textureW.

int

Value of textureH.

int

Value of matType.

textureIntrinsic

Matrix3x3

Value of textureIntrinsic.

textureDistortion

Distortion

Value of textureDistortion.

rotation

Matrix3x3

Value of rotation.

translation

double[]

Value of translation.

Returns: byte[]?`size `pointCloudW×pointCloudH×3×channelBytes;failed as null. matType=16 (CV_8UC3) Every channel at the time 1 Bytes;`matType=18 (CV_16UC3)` Every channel at the time 2 Bytes, small-end sequences. Depth source textures are usually 16 Bits, the element itself has to be passed on. MatType, otherwise sampled by error bytes long.

Example: Align texture by depth

EpicRawImage textureElement = EpicEye.DecodeImageFromEpicRaw(
    document,
    EpicRawDataType.TextureBGR)!;

var (depthBytes, depthWidth, depthHeight) = EpicEye.DecodeDepthFromEpicRaw(document);
if (depthBytes is null || depthWidth is null || depthHeight is null)
{
    return;
}

float[] depth = new float[depthBytes.Length / sizeof(float)];
Buffer.BlockCopy(depthBytes, 0, depth, 0, depthBytes.Length);

byte[]? aligned = EpicEye.AlignTextureFromDepth(
    depth,
    depthWidth.Value,
    depthHeight.Value,
    textureElement.Data.ToArray(),
    textureElement.Width,
    textureElement.Height,
    textureElement.MatType,
    depthIntrinsic,
    textureIntrinsic,
    textureDistortion,
    depthToTextureRotation,
    depthToTextureTranslation);
